messages:
Maya: kicking off Novara Labs onboarding — quick agenda: stakeholder roster, measurable success criteria, 30/60/90 milestones, enablement sessions, and renewal-risk flags. propose Wed 9am PT for kickoff call. who should be on the call from engineering & security?

Sam: Wed 9am PT works for CS. Adding preliminary stakeholder list: Novara: Emma (PM), Rishi (SRE), Talia (Data). From our side: Maya (CS), Sam (CS), Liz (PM), Alejandro (SE). @Alejandro can you confirm engineer lead? :thumbsup:

Alejandro: I can join Wed. I suggest we also have an infra contact — I'll invite Jordan from infra. main tech risk: custom VPC peering + private deployment timeline. need to know if they require HSM/KMS on day 1.

Liz: success criteria (proposed): 1) PoC inference flow running in staging with <=100ms p95 latency for 2k qps demo, 2) data ingestion validated (PII rules applied), 3) team able to self-run a smoke test, 4) adoption metric: 2 product teams using SDKs in first 30 days. capture these as measurable checkpoints.

Maya: good set. I'll make a short checklist doc and map owners. also capture renewal risk signals: long infra requirements, >2 week dependency on Novara infra, unclear success metric alignment with their execs. put an early-risk flag if HSM required or SOC2 evidence delayed.

Sam: enablement plan: two live sessions — "integration walkthru" (1.5h) and "ops & runbook" (1h). record both, add short how-to for token management and monitoring. Recommend a 60m Q/A two weeks post-go-live.

Alejandro: tech prep items for wed: 1) sample request payload and expected sequence lengths, 2) target throughput per route, 3) any custom model variants or quantization needs. if they want on-prem package we need lead time for infra baselines.

Maya: noted. I'll ask Novara for sample payloads and their security questionnaire. Sam — can you own feedback capture? want to collect session ratings + a 5-min follow-up survey after each enablement session.

Sam: yes, I'll set up a simple Google form and a short async feedback thread. will also add a Trello/board card for each action item and assign owners.

onboarding-bot: Created doc "Novara Onboard — Kickoff Checklist" at https://redwood.docs/novara-onboard (viewers: customer-success, eng-se).

Liz: timeline suggestions: Week 0 (kickoff + infra gating), Week 1 (staging integration + first enablement), Week 2 (performance tuning + security checklist), Week 3 (go/no-go + exec demo), Weeks 4-6 (rollout + adoption support). I'll draft 30/60/90 with owners.

Maya: great. For renewal-risk tracking: add columns in the onboarding doc for "blocker severity", "expected unblock ETA", "decision owner". we'll flag anything with >2 week ETA as "risk-high" and loop in AM.

Alejandro: FYI — if we need a dedicated GPU pool (Dedicated), we'd want a committed cadence estimate by day 7. delays there could push timeline.

Sam: noted. I'll surface committed capacity needs in the doc and estimate cost ranges for the AM to prep renewal-impact notes.

Maya: one more ask — capture two customer success metrics to monitor post-go-live: usage growth (weekly active routes) and quality regressions (error-inference rate + eval scores). we'll wire alerts into Console.

Liz: adding those. Also capture who on Novara will sign off on success criteria — Emma (PM) + their head of ML (Talia?) — confirm on call.

Maya: OK I'll send the calendar invite and pre-reads (doc + short questionnaire). agenda: intros, success criteria alignment, infra gating, enablement timeline, next actions. Thanks all :rocket:
